extraction.name: VoiceAssistant-Eval
extraction.description: VoiceAssistant-Eval is a comprehensive benchmark designed to assess AI assistants across listening, speaking, and viewing. It comprises 10,497 curated examples spanning 13 task categories.
extraction.creator: Ke Wang (CUHK MMLab); Houxing Ren (CUHK MMLab); Zimu Lu (CUHK MMLab); Mingjie Zhan (SenseTime Research); Hongsheng Li (CUHK MMLab; CPII under InnoHK)
extraction.citeAs: Ke Wang, Houxing Ren, Zimu Lu, Mingjie Zhan, Hongsheng Li. VOICEASSISTANT-EVAL: BENCHMARKING AI ASSISTANTS ACROSS LISTENING, SPEAKING, AND VIEWING. arXiv preprint arXiv:2509.22651v1, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was collected by extracting diverse visual and auditory inputs from existing datasets, including natural sounds, music, dialogue, and images. Additionally, text instructions were converted into synthesized speech using text-to-speech (TTS) models.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Approximately 10% of candidate items were discarded during validation due to being incomplete or unsuitable, which included cases with missing or broken audio or images.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data consists of visual and auditory inputs sourced from 47 existing datasets, including MMMU, RoleBench, and various other audio and text datasets containing natural sounds, music, human speech, and images.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Curators review each item on a single screen, with inline players and viewers, transcripts, and multiple-choice options when present, and then assign a Good or Bad verdict, along with optional notes.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: F5TTS; ChatTTS; Dia-1.6B; Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct; UTMOS Strong; Whisper-Large-v3
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The role-play subset uses a fixed set of 100 roles and associated style prompts. These roles may encode stereotypes or omit important user personas.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may still be limited in diversity with a monolingual focus (mostly English); gaps in task coverage and scenario realism (video-audio integration and continuous audio-visual streaming tasks are beyond the scope); evaluates models in an offline, static manner, which might not capture certain practical deployment factors.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The benchmark aims to enable research on personalization while minimizing harms related to impersonation, privacy violations, and unequal performance across demographics.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The benchmark includes role-play voice imitation and speaker similarity evaluation, requiring strict consent, provenance, and anti-impersonation safeguards to mitigate misuse risks like identity spoofing, harassment, and fraud.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: To better evaluate voice assistants and facilitate future studies in this area.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: We will maintain a data governance process for auditing and removal and reserve the right to update assets if consent or licensing concerns arise.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Text instructions were rewritten using Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct to make them more suitable for TTS, speech instructions were synthesized using three advanced text-to-speech (TTS) models, and balanced sampling was applied to equalize category representation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data was de-duplicated using a combination of lexical overlap and edit-distance matching. Incomplete or inappropriate items, including cases with missing or broken audio or images, ill-posed questions, or incorrect answers, were filtered out. Special tokens in text (e.g., '<image1>') were replaced with descriptive phrases.
